fix_commit.message: Avoid a use-after-free problem that could occur if ATTACH statements are executed while a backup operation is active. Bug [bugs:/info/2026-06-23T15:46:48Z | 2026-06-23T15:46:48Z].
fix_commit.author: dan

findings.title: Backup struct stores raw Db* pointer into aDb[] which may be reallocated by ATTACH
findings.message: The sqlite3_backup struct stores Db *pSrc and Db *pDest as direct pointers into the pSrcDb->aDb[] and pDestDb->aDb[] dynamic arrays. These pointers are obtained via findDatabase() which returns &pDb->aDb[i] — a raw pointer into the middle of a heap-allocated array. When an ATTACH statement is executed while a backup is active, SQLite reallocates the aDb[] array to accommodate the new database entry, potentially moving it to a new memory address. The stored Db* pointers then become dangling (pointing into freed memory). Any subsequent backup operation (sqlite3_backup_step, sqlite3_backup_finish, backupOnePage, etc.) that dereferences p->pSrc->pBt or p->pDest->pBt will access freed/reallocated memory, constituting a use-after-free.

location.snippet:
struct sqlite3_backup {
  sqlite3* pDestDb;        /* Destination database handle */
  Db *pDest;               /* Destination db file */
  u32 iDestSchema;         /* Original schema cookie in destination */
  int bDestLocked;         /* True once a write-transaction is open on pDest */

  Pgno iNext;              /* Page number of the next source page to copy */
  sqlite3* pSrcDb;         /* Source database handle */
  Db *pSrc;                /* Source db file */

findings.suggestion: Store the integer index of the database within pDb->aDb[] instead of a direct pointer to the array element. Dereference pDb->aDb[idx].pBt each time the Btree* is needed. This way, even if aDb[] is reallocated by ATTACH, the index remains valid and the pointer is always freshly derived from the current array base address.
findings.suggestion_code:
/* Replace Db *pSrc / Db *pDest in the struct with: */
int iSrc;   /* Index into pSrcDb->aDb[] */
int iDest;  /* Index into pDestDb->aDb[] (or pSrcDb->aDb[] when pDestDb==NULL) */

/* Access via macros: */
#define getSourceBtree(b) ((b)->pSrcDb->aDb[(b)->iSrc].pBt)
#define getDestBtree(b)   ((b)->pDestDb ? (b)->pDestDb->aDb[(b)->iDest].pBt \
                                        : (b)->pSrcDb->aDb[(b)->iDest].pBt)

ground_truth.root_cause: Commit 97901bbd changed sqlite3_backup from storing Btree* pointers directly to storing Db* pointers (element addresses within the aDb[] dynamic array). Since sqlite3 grows aDb[] via realloc() when ATTACH attaches a new database, any previously-cached &pDb->aDb[i] pointer becomes a dangling pointer into the freed old allocation.
